verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents programmatic creation of connected accounts for businesses and individuals, which covers seller onboarding. Its Transfers product can move funds to suppliers and contractors, but nothing ties those payouts to connected-account sellers. The sandbox also excludes the Connected Account APIs, so the platform flow cannot be tested there. Missing for 10: any documented payment-splitting between platform and sellers, payouts explicitly routed to connected-account sellers, sandbox support for Connected Account APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a marketplace build.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.
Airwallex Transfers allows you to move funds across the globe easily to your suppliers, employees, contractors and/or own bank accounts.
It gives you access to all products in the Airwallex web app and API (except Connected Account APIs)
